signature_moves: Violet modern-serif ITALIC on 'your voice' inside a heavy geometric-sans headline — entire brand promise in one two-word type swap (Von Restorff)
App icon is a deliberate TWIN of Apple Mail's envelope: same silhouette/flap-V, recolored onto the pink->violet gradient, + 2 AI sparkles (name-driven mimicry + Jakob's Law)
One magenta->blue gradient unifies icon, trial pill, and panel CTA — cheap cross-surface cohesion
'ILLUSTRATED WORKFLOW' disclaimer — candid that the product shot is illustrative, not a screenshot
defects: Faked chrome — 3 grey dots imitate a macOS traffic-light cluster on a card that is not a real window; implies a standalone Mac window a Mail plug-in doesn't have
Gradient-as-accent — decorative pink->violet->blue gradient stands in for a bound system accent; non-native the moment it enters real UI
Focal Collision (mild) — two saturated gradient CTAs in one viewport (trial pill + Insert button), region-separated
Contrast Dilution (minor) — 'ILLUSTRATED WORKFLOW' ~2:1 and lavender field border <3:1 fall below the 3:1 non-text floor

aesthetic.direction: Consumer AI-SaaS / soft-gradient — Playful-toy family (pill-everything, saturated pastels, soft elevation) crossed with the current lavender-gradient + sparkles AI-product template; NOT a native-macOS aesthetic
peers: Superhuman (email + warmth, but this is pinker/softer)
generic AI-writing-tool landing pages (Notion AI / GPT-wrapper marketing)

psychology: Von Restorff effect — the lone violet serif-italic 'your voice' is the remembered element; used well
Jakob's Law — icon mimics Apple Mail's trained envelope schema to signal 'works with your Mail'
Aesthetic-Usability effect — the polished pastel composite buys a perceived-usability/trust halo on first contact (marketing)
Demonstrate-don't-describe (description-experience gap) — the illustrated panel shows the 3-step flow (keywords -> tone chips -> reply -> insert) rather than describing it
Loss-aversion / commitment distance — '30-day full trial then $19.90 once' frames a one-time price (not a subscription) to lower commitment friction
Hick's Law / action singularity — the panel narrows to a single primary action, 'Insert reply into Mail'
notes: NO real macOS app UI in either image. cover.png is a 1200x630 marketing OG composite (~@1x); its right-side 'app window' is explicitly stamped ILLUSTRATED WORKFLOW = a stylised mock. MailTwin lives INSIDE Apple Mail ('Keep Apple Mail'), so it likely has no standalone AppKit window to digest. lineage set to web-electron/low to describe the ILLUSTRATION's design language only — treat as source:mock, contrast evidence, feeding ZERO macOS canon or native clusters. Icon (icon.png, 512x512) present as brand evidence: Big-Sur-flat squircle, envelope twin of Apple Mail + AI sparkles, brand gradient — could be run through Workflow B (icon) separately; not done here (task was Workflow A / UI only). All measurements are single-surface (estimated)(inferred) off a downscaled render — none promoted to confirmed. Re-digest if a genuine native surface (or the in-Mail plug-in UI) ever becomes available.
